capabilities: Displays tasks in month, week, and three-day hour-by-hour timeline views
Creates checklist tasks with due date, time range, priority, start date, and category tag
Archives tasks into language-matched yearly or monthly task-list notes
Marks lunar dates, statutory holidays, and makeup workdays
Filters tasks by category tags and reads dated checklist lines vault-wide
disambiguation: Not a recurring-monthly-task tool; it is a calendar view over plain checklist lines archived into yearly or monthly task-list notes.
extras: Holiday data is the only network use (holiday-cn CDN mirrors → timor.tech → built-in 2022–2026 fallback); requests carry just a year. No account, telemetry, or uploads; works offline for cached/built-in years. MIT license; requires Obsidian 0.15.0+.
problem: Obsidian shows checklist tasks only as lines in notes, with no calendar view of due dates, time ranges, and priorities across a month or week.

relations.evidence: holiday-cn — 社区维护，覆盖 2007 至今；经多个 CDN 镜像按顺序访问
timor.tech — 备份源。已知状况：目前对本插件返回 403/人机验证页，实际不起作用

summary: TickTick-style task calendar that lays plain checklist tasks onto month, week, and three-day timeline views with lunar dates and holiday markers.
